insights: Polynomial cross product 2·T_m·U_n = U_{m+n}+U_{n-m} holds in any CommRing R, proved purely from T and U recurrences without trigonometric evaluation
Paired induction Q(m) = P(m) ∧ P(m-1) is necessary because T recurrence T_{m+1}=2X·T_m-T_{m-1} requires two consecutive values
Helper lemma two_X_U (2·X·U_k = U_{k+1}+U_{k-1}) is a rearrangement of U_add_two with index shift — used in all three induction cases
The formula is asymmetric: U_{n-m} appears (not U_{m-n}), reflecting that U_{-k} ≠ U_k for second-kind Chebyshev polynomials
Sine spreading identity 2·cos θ·sin((n+1)θ) = sin((n+2)θ)+sin(nθ) follows as corollary via U_real_cos; requires nlinarith with sin²+cos²=1
linear_combination closes all three induction steps (forward, backward, base) after substituting T/U recurrence hypotheses
